name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connection to adult women belonging to poor households.
benefits: Free LPG connection + first refill and hotplate/stove free of cost
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Applicant and Adult Family Members

criteria.description: Applicant must be an adult woman
criteria.disqualification_reason: Ujjwala connection is exclusively issued in the name of an adult woman

criteria.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Must belong to BPL or underprivileged household
criteria.disqualification_reason: Household does not fall under BPL/deprived criteria
